name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires a switch_toggled event, but the environment says, “A setup can leave out the siren ... A missing siren has no switch.” In those setups, the event cannot occur, so this clause cannot be satisfied. Resolve the task requirement for setups without a switch.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires a switch flip, but the environment says, “A missing siren has no switch,” and the switch can only be toggled when present. In setups without a siren, switch_toggled can never occur, so this clause cannot be satisfied. The task’s switch-first requirement conflicts with those setups.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires flipping the switch first.

texts: Flip the switch before reaching the exit.
